name: Monthly Portfolio Operating Review

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.definition: Reported company revenue, using the existing verified report adapter's selected total; no summation of duplicate presentations or account detail.

metrics.label: Reported EBITDA
metrics.definition: Reported EBITDA for the source reporting entity; excludes pro forma adjusted EBITDA sensitivities and does not impose a common accounting definition.

context_fields.definition: Original reporting entity, not an inferred consolidation perimeter.
Original reporting period; a different grain cannot satisfy the monthly requirement.
Monthly, fiscal-quarter or annual; no annualization or resampling.
Original currency label; $ is retained without claiming an ISO currency or FX conversion.
Source-supported unit, with original scale preserved separately.
Version-qualified source identity, joined to workbook/sheet/cell lineage.
Preserve unknown when the source contract does not establish the basis.

assessment_policy: Report measured mapping, source and period checks separately. Do not compute a total readiness score without comprehensive validation/reconciliation evidence. Human approval and future-cycle mapping reuse are not inferred.
